Cross-timeframe split: 15m scanner LONG_BIAS (bounce off the lows, acceleration flat-to-positive) vs 4h SHORT_BIAS; continuum BELOW. The alt tape has diverged hard from BTC: 70/127 tokens LONG_BIAS, exactly 1 SHORT_BIAS (PURR). That divergence cuts both ways — alts can bid on their own rotation (WLD +8%/24h earlier, NXPC +3.0%/16 candles) but every long is one BTC wick from correlated stop-out, and with BTC below its 4h EMA that wick points down. Alignment rule stands: no LONG while BTC is BELOW with bearish linreg (precheck enforces it); shorts only on coins that are themselves SHORT_BIAS with R2>0.6 — which currently excludes every precheck-passing candidate. Trigger map: BTC reclaims ~81,807 EMA300 with rising volume -> pullback LONGs at meta_rsi 35-45 (67% WR cohort) become the trade; BTC loses ~81,000 with acceleration staying negative -> shorts on failed pops, on SHORT_BIAS coins only. Until one triggers, zero exposure is not caution, it is the highest-EV position on the board.

No third exit category. Winning side of the loser cohort: the trade with enough entry momentum to reach +0.40% before the ATR stop. Why we weren't on it: signals keep entering mid-band on coins with no coin-level trend, where +0.40% never comes. No exit-parameter tweak fixes this; only entry quality (coin-level regime at entry) does.

2. BTC PENDING FLIP-FLOP PAID TUITION TWICE (n=3, ~6h): ai-trader-pending LONG -1.67% (1.00h) and LONG -1.74% (2.07h) while BTC was below EMA300, then SHORT +1.56% atr_tp_hit (0.64h) once direction matched. Winning side of both longs was the short — the continuum already had the answer. Lesson for pending orders: with BTC BELOW, pending LONG triggers are counter-trend by construction; the queue should prefer failed-rally SHORT triggers in this state, not LONG retests.

3. The RSI bands of winners (40.7, 49.4, 50.0, 56.2, 57.1) and losers overlap — RSI does not separate them; independent coin momentum does.

4. SHORT COHORT IS 2/2 PATTERN-CHECKED: GOAT SHORT at meta_rsi 73.6 (above ceiling) lost -0.97% — chase/fade of an extreme; BTC SHORT at 10x in RECOVERY lost -5.36% yesterday; the only short win is the BTC pending short that matched the below-EMA300 tape. pump-chain- family: 46 trades, 23.9% WR, net -0.00 — pure noise.
